capabilities: Open a shell terminal in the right sidebar or main area
Create terminal tabs, split right or down, and restart exited shells
Read font, color, cursor, scrollback, shell, and keybind settings from Ghostty config files
Start a terminal in the selected folder or file parent from the file explorer
Prepare a terminal-like PATH, locale, TERM, and shell environment for GUI-launched Obsidian
disambiguation: It is not a code-execution or build tool; it only provides terminal surfaces in the workspace.
extras: Desktop-only and restricted to macOS on Apple Silicon; other platforms show a message and never start the helper. Runs shell commands with the same permissions as Obsidian, which the README flags as a security consideration; no telemetry or network access at runtime. Installable via BRAT or manual release files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a local shell terminal inside the workspace next to your notes.

relations.evidence: Ghostty-style terminal surfaces inside your workspace

summary: Terminal emulator plugin that opens shell tabs and splits in the sidebar or main workspace using a bundled Rust PTY helper.
